newsitem.title: FRANCE: Ex-shipyard workers block trains in south France.
newsitem.headline: Ex-shipyard workers block trains in south France.

text.p: Some 2,000 train passengers were briefly stranded in southern France on Friday when around 100 former shipyard employees blocked rail lines to and from disused yards at La Ciotat on the Riviera, state rail company SNCF said.
Three trains were brought to a standstill on the line from Nice to Marseille, while a high speed TGV train bound for Nice was halted at Marseille.
"The SNCF condemns these illegal intrigues which make the SNCF and its customers hostages," the company said in a statement. It was setting up a bus shuttle to transport the rail passengers.
Trade unions charged that the government had failed to keep a pledge to partially reopen the of the La Ciotat shipyard.
